name: kernelgen-codex
description: Repo-local Codex workflows for kernelGen development.

interface.longDescription: Provides repo-local Codex skills for bead implementation, review, GEMM kernel writing, and profiling, designed to run in the same bead and worktree flow as the existing Claude setup.
defaultPrompt: Implement the next ready kernelGen bead in a sandboxed worktree.
Review the current kernelGen diff for correctness and validation gaps.
Optimize a native HIP GEMM kernel for gfx1100.
Profile a GEMM provider and report the top bottlenecks.
